heading: Weddings at Sane Living
intro:
The Sane Living Center is a beautiful auditorium and gathering venue located at 316 E. Matilija St, Ojai, CA 93023.

This high technology space has hosted a wide variety of events including special occasions and private celebrations, and is available for weddings and receptions.
highlights: Soundproof auditorium in downtown Ojai — events can run later than 10 pm when needed
Outdoor space also available to rent
Conference Room or Annex for getting ready / breakout space
pricingText: Wedding packages starting at $1,500. Each quote is based on your guest count and needs. Call (805) 646-6000 for a custom quote.
cateringPolicy: Outside caterers are welcome. Caterers must provide proof of insurance and follow the venue's load-in, cleanup, and house rules.
alcoholPolicy: Clients may bring their own alcohol (no corkage fee) with their own liquor license/permit. Anyone serving alcohol must carry their own insurance.
availabilityNote: Purple dates on the calendar are not available.
